title: Logistics Management
overview: Logistics management is a critical function that oversees the flow of goods within a supply chain. This course, offered in collaboration with the UK-based Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT), provides an up-to-date understanding of the latest logistics models and practices. The primary focus is on optimizing transportation, warehousing, and inventory management activities. Additionally, the course covers the Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) framework to effectively manage key logistics performance indicators.
audience: This course is suitable for logistics professionals at all organizational levels. It is particularly beneficial for individuals looking to enhance their supply chain and logistics expertise with the latest theoretical knowledge in preparation for advancing to higher positions within their organization.
methodology: The course utilizes various exercises and case studies from both regional and international contexts. Participants will often collaborate in pairs and larger groups throughout the training.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Recognize contemporary supply chain and logistics trends that support sustainable performance
Utilize qualitative and quantitative material forecasting techniques to streamline logistics operations
Develop go-to-market strategies for various product categories, considering associated supply risks and financial impacts
Explain the role of transportation in logistics and identify opportunities for operational enhancements
Understand the importance of warehousing, with an emphasis on operational throughput and performance optimization
Apply the SCOR framework to manage the strategic, operational, and tactical aspects of logistics
